stem:
Valine (Val) and lysine (Lys) are amino acids. The structures of these amino acids can be found in the Data Booklet.

The isoelectric point of an amino acid is the pH at which it exists as a zwitterion. The isoelectric point of valine is 6.0. The isoelectric point of lysine is 9.7.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Draw the structure of valine at pH 6.0.

parts.label: (b)
(c)
parts.text: Draw the structure of the dipeptide Val-Lys. The peptide bond should be shown fully displayed.
